### Bible Pathway - Sept. 30, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-30-2010-11638856.html
Passage: Malachi 3:8-9
Points:
- Generations after the exile became indifferent to God's Word and withheld what belonged to Him.
- God directly charged His people with robbery for withholding their tithes and offerings.
- Giving back to God demonstrates faithful stewardship and acknowledges that He owns everything.
- Withholding resources reflects spiritual apathy and deprives God's house and ministry of support.
- Believers are called to honor the Lord with their firstfruits and give with cheerful hearts.
